scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && cp LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md dist/
scripts.build:webstore: tsc --noEmit && VITE_EDITION=webstore vite build && cp LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md dist-webstore/
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../youtubook-v$npm_package_version.zip && zip -rX ../youtubook-v$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.zip:webstore: npm run build:webstore && cd dist-webstore && rm -f ../youtubook-lite-v$npm_package_version.zip && zip -rX ../youtubook-lite-v$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
